title: The ZDX API from a client's side: hosts, limits, conventions, coverage and wire notes

prose.text: Endpoint lists, HTTP methods, request and response fields, and the Go and Python SDK functions for ZDX are generated from the captured contract and the SDKs: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface zdx` and read `vendor/zscaler-api-specs/automate-zscaler/openapi/zdx.openapi.json`. This subject family holds only the behavior around them and the places where those sources disagree.

prose.label: Calling the API.
prose.text: Hosts and signing in, on the OneAPI gateway or the direct ZDX host, are in [[zdx.api.hosts-and-auth]]. Limits and how the clients pace themselves are in [[zdx.api.rate-limits]]. Time ranges, paging and how API numbers relate to the console are in [[zdx.api.conventions]]. What each SDK covers, and the configuration API neither calls, is in [[zdx.api.client-coverage]].

prose.label: Wire notes by area.
prose.text: Deep traces: [[zdx.diagnostics.start-request]] and [[zdx.diagnostics.session-records]]. Score analysis: [[zdx.diagnostics.analysis]]. Alerts: [[zdx.alerts]]. Snapshots: [[zdx.alerts.snapshot]].

prose.label: Clients.
prose.text: The Python SDK's request shaping, result models and legacy client are in [[zdx.sdk-python]]; the Go SDK's struct defects and direct client are in [[zdx.sdk-go]]; the MCP server's deep-trace tools are in [[zdx.diagnostics.mcp-tools]]. Behavior shared by all Go products is in [[shared.sdk-go.request-handling]] and [[shared.sdk-go.retries]].
